ayahs.en: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We have granted you ˹O Prophet˺ abundant goodness

ayahs.en: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone]
ayahs.e2: So pray and sacrifice to your Lord ˹alone˺

ayahs.en: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off
ayahs.e2: Only the one who hates you is truly cut off ˹from any goodness˺
